dogecoin.text: People think I’m lying when I say I moved from suburban Florida to rural Mongolia because I made money on Dogecoin and wanted peace. But here we are.
In 2019, I found the old Dogecoin wallet. It had grown to $7,000. I couldn’t believe it. Rolled that into Ethereum and Solana early. By 2021, I was comfortably seven figures deep.
In 2013, someone on Xbox Live told me to get into Dogecoin. I mined a bit on my old Dell desktop for the memes. Forgot about it.
